name: ADESTE FIDELES
confidence: high for the notes; check bars 8 and 12
source: Open Hymnal Project ABC score (The Hymnal, Episcopal, 1916); checked against the score on Wikipedia's article.
reviewNotes: The two sources agree on every pitch and on the underlay of the ending ('Him' over soh-doh, 'Christ' over te-lah). They differ in two places: bar 8 (here 'Beth-le-hem' ends with a crotchet rest; Wikipedia holds 'hem' a whole bar) and bar 12 (here 'an-gels' is fah. me ray; Wikipedia fah - ray, without the passing me). Check both against your book. musicPublished is the first printing of the tune (1782); Wade's manuscripts are older.
